name: Devilin Levin
description: Touch or hold a block and turn into it. Gain strength and defense based on the block, but become slower depending on how much defense you have. Arms can become weapons: mace, hammer, and scythe. Leap: a jump ability that's on a 5 second cooldown.

select.title: Absorb
select.description: Touch or hold a block to absorb its properties and turn into it.
commands: execute as @s at @s run function mutants:powers/kevin

transform.title: Transform
transform.description: Transform into an alien using absorbed DNA.

cycle_next.title: Next Alien
cycle_next.description: Cycle to the next alien form.

detransform_safe.title: Purge Omnitrix
detransform_safe.description: Force-remove stuck Omnitrix and alien forms.
commands: execute as @s at @s run superpower remove alienevo_aliens:all
execute as @s at @s run superpower remove alienevo:prototype_omnitrix
execute as @s at @s run superpower remove alienevo:transform_bubble
execute as @s at @s run superpower remove alienevo:transform_bubble_tout
execute as @s at @s run superpower remove alienevo:all
execute as @s at @s run superpower remove aeo:all
execute as @s at @s run tag @s remove AlienEvo.Transformation
execute as @s at @s run tag @s remove AlienEvo.MasterControl
execute as @s at @s run scoreboard players set @s AlienEvo.NoCore 1
execute as @s at @s run scoreboard players set @s AlienEvo.Playlist 0
execute as @s at @s run scoreboard players set @s AlienEvo.Slot 0
execute as @s at @s run clear @s alienevo:prototype_omnitrix
execute as @s at @s run clear @s alienevo:omniverse_omnitrix
execute as @s at @s run clear @s aeo:completed_omnitrix

access_omnitrix.title: Access Omnitrix
access_omnitrix.description: Force-enable Omnitrix access after core absorption.
commands: execute as @s at @s run superpower remove alienevo:prototype_omnitrix
execute as @s at @s run superpower add alienevo:prototype_omnitrix
execute as @s at @s run scoreboard players set @s AlienEvo.NoCore 0
execute as @s at @s run scoreboard players set @s AlienEvo.Playlist 1
execute as @s at @s run scoreboard players set @s AlienEvo.Slot 1

extract_core.title: Reset Core
extract_core.description: Force-remove stuck Omnitrix state and give one clean core.
commands: execute as @s at @s run superpower remove alienevo_aliens:all
execute as @s at @s run superpower remove alienevo:prototype_omnitrix
execute as @s at @s run superpower remove alienevo:transform_bubble
execute as @s at @s run superpower remove alienevo:transform_bubble_tout
execute as @s at @s run superpower remove alienevo:all
execute as @s at @s run superpower remove aeo:all
execute as @s at @s run tag @s remove AlienEvo.Transformation
execute as @s at @s run tag @s remove AlienEvo.MasterControl
execute as @s at @s run scoreboard objectives add kevin_core_count dummy
execute as @s at @s store result score @s kevin_core_count run clear @s alienevo:prototype_core 0
execute as @s at @s if score @s kevin_core_count matches 2.. run clear @s alienevo:prototype_core
execute as @s at @s if score @s kevin_core_count matches 0 run give @s alienevo:prototype_core 1
execute as @s at @s if score @s kevin_core_count matches 2.. run give @s alienevo:prototype_core 1
